headline: 🔴 FortiMail CVE-2026-104286 zero-day exploited and KEV-listed, 🛡️ Warlock ransomware widens SharePoint attacks on critical infrastructure, 🚔 Operation KillSwitch dismantles KillSec and arrests its 16-year-old admin, 🍎 Public PoC for Apple CoreGraphics CVE-2026-86950, 🔓 Unpatched CVSS 10 Erlang/OTP TLS 1.3 client auth bypass, 🎭 Microsoft X account hijacked for $Clippy crypto scam
summary: Fortinet confirmed a CVSS 9.8 FortiMail zero-day with no fixed release available yet while law enforcement seized KillSec's infrastructure, Warlock's China-linked operators widened SharePoint exploitation to water and telecom targets, and a public Apple PoC plus an unpatched Erlang/OTP auth bypass set the patch agenda.

overrides.why: Same CVE as the lead; its bare Oct 1 KEV listing is superseded by Fortinet's own advisory and folded into the FortiMail paragraph.
Its Oct 1 events are re-reports of the Sept 30 CVE-2026-76504 KEV add, not a development on CVE-2026-20245 itself.
Oct 1 events are outlet re-reports of the RedFlick/CosmicPulse disclosure already covered in the Sept 30 digest; no new substance.
Only outlet re-reports of the Zammad zero-day disclosure covered in the Oct 1 digest.
Only a re-report of Microsoft's disclosure already covered in the Oct 1 digest.
No events since the Oct 1 coverage; nothing new to report on the Fireware OS batch.
The Oct 1 event is a stub link to a Star Labs writeup of a different CVE (CVE-2026-113337 AF_ALG) the story analysis doesn't cover, so no grounded delta.
Its dev=today timestamp is a social re-share of a Sept 11 Register article, not a same-day development.
Score 2.8 under-ranks an unpatched CVSS 10 flaw where a malicious server impersonates any host by bypassing TLS 1.3 client auth in a core runtime.
Score 2.1 under-ranks a $387.5M exchange breach delivered via zero-days in two third-party security appliances; never covered in any digest and the Sept 30 vector detail is materially new to readers.
